title: Wiczenbach 2025 thoracic PLL averaged nominal stress-strain curve (Th1-Th12)

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: authors' averaged curve (magenta, Fig 6): first Piola-Kirchhoff stress P11 = F/A0 (nominal stress) vs stretch lambda1 = (L0+u)/L0; x_value given as nominal strain = (lambda1 - 1) x 100 %; stretch kept in x_stretch

source.authors: Wiczenbach T, Wolny R, Sabik A, Pachocki L, Spodnik E, Witkowski W
source.sample: same 4 thoracic spines as Wolny 2024 (body donors); 17 ALL, 19 PLL, 31 CL, 17 LF, 16 ISL+SSL BLB samples; human thoracic ligaments Th1-Th12, BLB samples (same experimental series as Wolny 2024)

protocol.summary: Bone-ligament-bone samples (frozen -20 C, thawed in saline), bones reinforced and potted in PMMA cups; preload 5 N at 0.5 /s, 60 s relaxation; preconditioning 60 cycles at 10% strain, 1 Hz, 60 s rest; tension at constant strain rate 0.5 /s to rupture; environmental chamber 36.6 C, >=95% humidity. Failure = point where further elongation gives no force increase. Transition points I/II = start/end of linear region (<1% deviation between polynomial fit and linear approximation).
how_to_simulate: Model the thoracic ligament (bone-ligament-bone) with the Table 1 L0 and A0
Apply a 5 N preload (defines L0), then quasi-static tension along the fibres to failure
Report nominal stress F/A0 at the listed nominal strains (L - L0)/L0

extraction.uncertainty: x +/-0.003, y +/-0.25 MPa (line half-width at 300 dpi)
extraction.check_notes: Embedded 300-ppi raster; axes calibrated on tick marks and grid lines; magenta averaged line isolated by colour (RGB ~245,5,245); y = median of line pixels in +/-1.5 px column window. Re-read 2 points per panel by overlaying markers on the figure - on the line. Curve end matches Table 2 failure stretch (ALL 1.62, PLL 1.34, LF 1.30, CL 1.29, ISL+SSL 1.49).

pass_rule.rule: model nominal stress-strain curve within the spread of sample curves; compare against the averaged curve
